signal_family.method: two-sided empirical Bernstein using separate conservative calibration endpoints; 88 one-sided functions; delta=.03
signal_family.formula: h=sqrt(2*s2*ln(4*44/.03)/N)+7*R*ln(4*44/.03)/(3*(N-1)); sample variance ddof1; R=2 differences,1.9 NI,1 efficiencies; clip bounds to support

calibration_uncertainty.method: q=1-alpha; L=binom.ppf(delta/(2*16),N,q); U=binom.ppf(1-delta/(2*16),N,q)+1, one-based order statistics, +/-infinity sentinels outside1..N; conservative with atoms; opposite endpoints for candidate/reference, never deploy these endpoints
calibration_uncertainty.ties: reject ties; report mass at cutoff and actual achievable rate; no randomized tie breaking

background_uncertainty.method: simultaneous Clopper-Pearson intervals on final background; mean neural FPR interval is average of three simultaneous seed intervals

decisions.positive: both primary topologies meet NI+utility+rate-comparability and compact cost advantage; no claim beyond selected ADC population/finite seeds
decisions.simple_dominance: baseline-minus-compact simultaneous lower efficiency difference >.01 on both primary topologies, primary utility/rate comparable, baseline joint B32 cost meets .75/.80 block rule; report simpler selector preferred
decisions.negative: valid simultaneous upper bound excludes primary NI or utility, or compact has no computational advantage; report all candidates and seed/topology failures
decisions.inconclusive: intervals cross decision margins, rates not comparable, insufficient unique counts, any incomplete fit, missing cost/parity/source validity; never pick easier operating point
decisions.validity_failure: stop final evaluation, retain all exposures/partial work; no silent reuse of exposed final test. Corrections before freeze may use generated data only, within the same six real fits; later fixes need explicit amended design and protected population
